newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch police find babies' parts in voodoo dolls.
newsitem.headline: Dutch police find babies' parts in voodoo dolls.

text.p: Dutch police said on Friday they had discovered the mummified parts of three babies, some stuffed inside plastic voodoo dolls, at the Amsterdam home of a Surinamese-born man.
The mummified remains of a fourth infant were found at another house in the city.
"We don't know where the babies were from -- the Netherlands or from abroad. We don't even know how old they were," police spokesman Klaas Wilting told Dutch television.
A 45-year-old man, identified only as 'R', was being held, police said. A second man had been released after questioning.
Police said they made the discovery during a search earlier this week of a house in the south of the city in the course of a rape investigation.
Forensic scientists were examining the remains.
